title: Puffed Plantain Strudel
description: A unique dessert fusion of Venezuelan plantains and German pastry, puffed to perfection.
instructions: Peel the plantains and slice them into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
In a bowl, mix together sugar and cinnamon (if using).
Add the plantain slices to the bowl and toss to coat with sugar mixture.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Arrange the plantain slices on one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with melted butter.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the plantains and press the edges to seal.
Use a knife to trim any excess pastry and create a decorative edge.
Place the strudel on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the top with remaining butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
